conclusion: DRAW on predictive accuracy for Oct 5 under a leak-free apples-to-apples test. V2 architecture is better for uncertainty handling, but its predictive refinements require structured pre-cutoff venue/standings/xG/opponent-strength evidence to be persisted before the match.
